title: Imam Aaj bhi Zehra ki qabr tooti hai
body:
Al Ajal Ya Imame Zamana Ajtf. Al Ajal
imam Ajtf. Aaj Bhi Zehra S.a. Ki Qabr Tooti Hai.
batool S.a. Aaj Bhi Ummat Ke Zulm Sehti Hai...
1. Giraya Tha Isi Bibi Pe Jalta Darwaza.
aur Aaj Bhi Isi Bibi S.a. Pe Zulm Jaari Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Rida Se Saaya Kiya Tha Rasool Saww. Par Jisne.
usi Ki Qabr Pe Har Roz Dhoop Padhti Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Kiya Layeeno Ne Mismaar Qabre Zehra S.a. Ko.
yeh Ahlebait Saww. Se Ummat Ki Qadardani Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Sitamgaro'n Ka Hai Pehra Baqi Pe Shaam O Seher.
qudayi Roti Hai Is Par Yeh Kaisi Waadi Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Lehed Ko Dekhke Dadi Ki Rote Hai Sajjad Asws.
batool Zadi S.a. Ki Ghurbat Pe Ashk Jaari Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Kumail Mirza Qabar Hai Baqi Ki Moula Ko.
mere Imam Ajtf. Ki Aankho'n Se Qoon Jaari Hai.
